sourceSnapshotExplanation: The complete source map is recovered from finalSourceSha256 by replacing the four completeCampaignSourceOverrides. Both campaigns checked 648 code/configuration files and observed no mutation during their gates. Documentation and evidence are outside this source snapshot.
verifiedScenarios: Real local HTTP API -> admission RPC SQL -> delivery identity -> worker -> loop -> logger -> receipt close -> public status, with inert external effects.
Lost SQL or queue acknowledgement retains the admitted brief and its stable delivery identity.
A reused submission identity with different text or owner is rejected; another pending brief is not overwritten.
An exact requested brief cannot fall back to another ready or pending brief.
Simulation reads without consumption, and a later explicit live dispatch preserves its distinct delivery identity.
An uncertain external effect requires reconciliation and cannot automatically replay.
A resolved old approval cannot consume a fresh brief; automatic continuation of these brief missions remains suspended.
The pending slot is kept in the 20-item status list; an older omitted receipt remains accessible by its exact identifier.
Service-only RPC privileges, restrictive pending_brief RLS and owner/agent isolation are exercised in the local SQL harness.
The proxy tests validate strict action schemas, bounded body and response reads, owner derivation, projected DTOs, timeout and error handling.

knownLimitations: No PostgreSQL native multi-connection contention qualification, real Redis/BullMQ cluster, Supabase/PostgREST authenticated round trip, deployed Edge runtime or external provider call.
No migration applied, no main branch merge and no production deployment by this work.
No full automatic continuation of brief missions after approval; the existing durable receipt remains for reconciliation.
Idempotency relies on retaining durable admission/execution records and preserving request identities; it is not semantic deduplication across different missions.
The proxy limiter is per-instance memory, not a distributed quota reservation or a commercial quota guarantee.
PR21 uses conflicting migration numbers and a separate continuation context; it is not imported without contract reconciliation.
Local gate durations are not product latency benchmarks. No universal capability, uniqueness, power, price or speed ranking is established.
